verdict.rationale: Confirmed malicious attack with successful sensitive data access.

summary: During 2026-07-17 22:53:46 – 2026-07-17 22:53:48, a confirmed true-positive attack from 185.220.101.42 progressed through Credential Access, Discovery, Initial Access, and Lateral Movement. Observable activity included managed identity token acquisition from IMDS, ARM enumeration, device-code and client_secret sign-ins involving graph-mail-reader-app-id, Key Vault secret retrieval, storage account key retrieval for PRODDATA001, and mailbox access to cfo@contoso.com.

representationNotes.commentary: Attack graph names Key Vault resource as prod-credentials-kv, while compromised entities and evidence identify /.../VAULTS/PROD-SECRETS-KV with secret graph-sp-secret. Both labels are retained separately without asserting equivalence.

Entity label 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc differs from subscription identifiers shown elsewhere ending in 123456789ABC. Case and value normalization were not resolved beyond source-faithful retention.
Source entity types 'Cloud App' and 'Key Vault / Secret' were mapped to supported schema types application and secret, causing normalization loss.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Add native entity types for cloud-app and key-vault-secret

representationNotes.commentary: Summary states data access/exfiltration confirmed, but the timeline explicitly evidences mailbox item access and key/secret retrieval; no explicit exfiltration event with transferred data volume or destination is provided.

Mailbox entity lists additional identifier 3cbaa028-f049-4c3b-b260-85a7c91069f8 only, while timeline shows four distinct OfficeActivity AppIds accessing the mailbox. All four AppIds are retained as separate observed application entities.
Evidence item ev8 consolidates two Key Vault SecretGet records into one normalized evidence record to preserve event ordering without duplicating the same source action title.
representationNotes.suggestedVocabularyExtension: Support grouped evidence arrays per event

representationNotes.commentary: Attack graph relation 'retrieved secret' points to graph-sp-secret rather than the Key Vault container resource. Relationship rel9 targets the secret-name entity to match graph wording, while event evt8 references both secret name and Key Vault resource.
